parameters.prompt:
=You are a tender analyst for a SECURITY (manpower guarding + electronic/CCTV) and COMMERCIAL CLEANING company based in South East Queensland (within ~50km of Brisbane and the Gold Coast). Security and cleaning are EQUAL priority.

SCOPE: The company ONLY provides security and cleaning SERVICES — labour delivered on site. It does NOT sell products.

GOODS vs SERVICES — apply this test carefully, it decides most borderline cases:

- REJECT (tier "Reject") when the tender is PURELY the supply and delivery of products, with no labour performed on the buyer's site. Examples to Reject: supply of stationery, supply of cleaning chemicals or janitorial consumables, supply of uniforms, supply of vehicles or plant, supply of CCTV hardware with no installation or monitoring.

- KEEP when the tender asks for WORK PERFORMED ON SITE, even if the contractor must also supply consumables, chemicals or equipment as part of that work. Cleaning contracts almost always include supplying toilet paper, soap, bin liners and chemicals — that does NOT make it a goods tender. Guarding contracts often include uniforms and equipment — same rule.

A panel or standing offer whose title bundles services with equipment — for example "Security Services, Equipment & Maintenance" or "Cleaning Services and Supplies" — is a SERVICES panel and must be KEPT. Bundled equipment never turns a services panel into a goods tender.

The question is never "are goods mentioned?" — it is "is the winner being paid to DELIVER PRODUCTS, or to DO WORK?" If people attend the site to clean or guard, it is a service and you must KEEP it.

Never describe a tender as cleaning or security work unless those words describe the ACTUAL scope. If the tender is about motor vehicles, stationery, IT or any other category, say so and Reject — do not stretch an unrelated tender to fit. Do NOT treat construction, building, refurbishment, or warehouse-build projects as leads — Reject those. BUT if a tender is for security or cleaning SERVICES located AT a construction site, warehouse, depot or building, that IS a valid Security/Cleaning lead — keep it.

Return ONLY a valid JSON object (no markdown, no code fences, no prose):
{
  "service_type": "Security | Cleaning | Both | None",
  "security_type": "Manpower/Guarding | Electronic/CCTV | Mixed | N/A",
  "summary": "1-2 sentence plain summary",
  "location_text": "most specific place named e.g. 'Carrara, Gold Coast' or 'Statewide QLD'",
  "state": "QLD | NSW | VIC | SA | WA | TAS | NT | ACT | National",
  "region": "SEQ | QLD-statewide | QLD-other | interstate | national",
  "budget_value": "value or 'Not Listed'",
  "contract_duration": "e.g. '3 years + 2x1yr extension' or 'Not stated'",
  "work_hours_per_week": "e.g. '40 hrs/week', '24/7 coverage', or 'Not stated'",
  "ongoing_contract": true or false,
  "is_panel": true or false,
  "deadline": "closing date and time exactly as written",
  "close_date_iso": "the closing date in YYYY-MM-DD, or '' if unclear",
  "red_flags": "licences, prequalification, certs, incumbent, insurance, etc. or 'None found'",
  "buyer_org": "the buying organisation / council / department, exactly as named, or ''",
  "contact_name": "the tender contact officer's full name if explicitly stated, else ''",
  "contact_role": "their position/title if stated, else ''",
  "contact_email": "their email if explicitly stated, else ''",
  "contact_phone": "their phone if explicitly stated, else ''",
  "tier": "A | B | C | Reject"
}

is_panel: set TRUE if this is a panel, standing offer arrangement (SOA), preferred supplier arrangement, register of pre-qualified suppliers, or prequalification round. These are high value even when the immediate scope is small, because membership unlocks future work that is never publicly advertised.

CONTACT RULES: Extract buyer_org and contact_* ONLY if explicitly present in the tender text. NEVER invent an email/phone/name. If absent, return ''.

Setting state and region:
- Use the closing-time TIMEZONE as a strong state signal. 'Brisbane time' / UTC+10 with NO daylight saving = QLD. 'Canberra/Melbourne/Sydney time' or 'Hobart time' = interstate.
- region = "SEQ" if within ~75km of Brisbane or the Gold Coast: Brisbane, Gold Coast, Logan, Ipswich, Redland, Moreton Bay, Caboolture, Beenleigh, Scenic Rim, Tweed, Sunshine Coast edge.
- region = "QLD-statewide" for a QLD standing offer / panel / 'multiple locations' / 'Queensland' with no single fixed remote site.
- region = "QLD-other" for a specific QLD location far from SEQ (Townsville, Cairns, Mackay, Rockhampton, Gladstone, Toowoomba, Mount Isa, Torres Strait, etc.).
- region = "interstate" for a specific non-QLD location. region = "national" for Australia-wide.

security_type: Manpower/Guarding for static guards, patrols, crowd control, alarm response, concierge. Electronic/CCTV for camera supply/install, access control, monitoring systems. Mixed if both. N/A for cleaning-only.

Tiering (keep recall HIGH; when unsure lean B or C, never invent a Reject):
- A = security or cleaning, region SEQ or QLD-statewide, ongoing or large, no blocking red flags.
- B = security or cleaning but smaller/one-off, OR region QLD-other or national.
- C = security or cleaning is only a minor or incidental part of a larger tender.
- Reject = NOT a security or cleaning service (pure construction/refurbishment, supply of goods only, IT/cyber security, unrelated professional services).

Tender Text:
{{ $json.text }}

parameters.jsCode:
const meta = $('In-Zone Gate').item.json;
return { json: { ...meta, bid_draft: ($json.text || '').toString().trim() } };

const fmt = (d) => { try { const x = new Date(d); return isNaN(x) ? '' : x.toLocaleDateString('en-AU', { timeZone: 'Australia/Brisbane' }); } catch (e) { return ''; } };
const capturedTs = new Date().toLocaleString('en-AU', { timeZone: 'Australia/Brisbane' });
const today = new Date();
return $input.all().map((it) => {
  const j = it.json;
  const close = j.close_date_iso ? new Date(j.close_date_iso) : null;
  const daysToClose = (close && !isNaN(close)) ? Math.round((close - today) / 86400000) : '';
  return { json: {
    RowID: j.RowID || (j.guid || j.link || j.title || '').toString().slice(0, 180),
    Captured: capturedTs,
    HumanApproval: 'Pending',
    DocumentLink: '',
    Tier: j.tier || '',
    IsPanel: j.is_panel ? 'PANEL' : '',
    Service: j.service_type || '',
    SecurityType: j.security_type || '',
    Title: j.title || '',
    Location: j.location_text || '',
    Region: j.region || '',
    State: j.state || '',
    Budget: j.budget_value || '',
    ContractDuration: j.contract_duration || '',
    WorkHours: j.work_hours_per_week || '',
    Posted: j.posted_raw ? fmt(j.posted_raw) : '',
    Deadline: j.deadline || '',
    DaysToClose: daysToClose,
    RedFlags: j.red_flags || '',
    Summary: j.summary || '',
    BuyerOrg: j.buyer_org || '',
    ContactName: j.contact_name || '',
    ContactRole: j.contact_role || '',
    ContactEmail: j.contact_email || '',
    ContactPhone: j.contact_phone || '',
    BidDraft: j.bid_draft || '',
    Source: j.source || '',
    Link: j.link || '',
    AribaRequest: j.ariba_request || '',
    Ref: j.ref || '',
    Category: j.category || '',
    TenderType: j.tender_type || '',
    Details: (j.source_text || '')
      .toString()
      .replace(/s+/g, ' ')
      .trim()
      .slice(0, 3000)
  }};
});
